substances.name: fresh_water
substances.notes: Distilled/fresh water at atmospheric pressure. Density and kinematic viscosity are the ITTC recommended values (1 atm); dynamic viscosity is derived as rho*nu per the ITTC definition.

source.ref: ITTC Recommended Procedures and Guidelines 7.5-02-01-03 (2011), Fresh water and seawater properties, Table 2
source.note: values transcribed from the ITTC 1-atm fresh-water table at 5 degC intervals

density.accuracy: table values; linear interpolation error < 0.01 kg/m^3 over 5 degC intervals

source.ref: ITTC Recommended Procedures and Guidelines 7.5-02-01-03 (2011), Table 2 (fresh water kinematic viscosity)
source.note: the 15 degC anchor 1.1883e-06 m^2/s quoted in the ITTC-1957 model-ship correlation line refers to seawater, see sea_water

viscosity_kinematic.applicability: 0-30 degC, 1 atm; used for Reynolds number in model-scale resistance work

source.ref: derived identity mu = rho * nu (ITTC 7.5-02-01-03 definition)
source.note: inherits the provenance of the density and kinematic-viscosity tables

viscosity_dynamic.accuracy: 0.04% agreement with the Kestin-type Vogel correlation at 20 degC (1.0016e-03 vs 1.002e-03 Pa*s)

substances.name: sea_water
substances.notes: Standard seawater at salinity S = 35 g/kg (35 ppt), 1 atm. This is the fluid assumed by the ITTC-1957 model-ship correlation line.

source.ref: ITTC Recommended Procedures and Guidelines 7.5-02-01-03 (2011), Table 3 (seawater, S = 35 g/kg)

density.accuracy: table values; +/-0.05 kg/m^3 for S within 30-38 g/kg (ITTC graph)

source.ref: ITTC Recommended Procedures and Guidelines 7.5-02-01-03 (2011), Table 3 (seawater kinematic viscosity)
source.note: 15 degC value 1.1883e-06 m^2/s is the standard viscosity quoted for the ITTC-1957 correlation line

viscosity_kinematic.accuracy: table values; correlation-line anchor reproduced exactly at 15 degC
viscosity_kinematic.applicability: 0-30 degC, 1 atm, S = 35 g/kg; model-ship extrapolation

source.note: inherits provenance of the seawater density and viscosity tables

viscosity_dynamic.accuracy: 0.06% agreement with Sharqawy et al. (2010) seawater viscosity correlation at 20 degC, S = 35
